name: "The Elephant Man" Screening
description: Join a free public screening of David Lynch's 1980 masterpiece at the Abel Salazar Institute for Biomedical Sciences for a haunting and unforgettable cinematic experience.
longDescription:
On October 22, 2026, the Abel Salazar Institute for Biomedical Sciences (ICBAS) will host a public screening of David Lynch's 1980 film, "The Elephant Man." This event offers an opportunity to view the acclaimed drama, which garnered eight Academy Award nominations, including Best Picture and Best Director. The screening is presented as a free cultural offering within the city of Porto, focusing on cinematic art.

Attendees can expect a contemplative atmosphere for this black-and-white historical drama, which runs for approximately 2 hours and 4 minutes. The film is presented in English with no information available regarding subtitles. The ICBAS venue, part of the University of Porto, provides a formal academic setting for the viewing.

Admission to the screening is free, and no prior registration or ticketing information has been provided, suggesting walk-in attendance is welcome. ICBAS is located near the Hospital de Santo António, accessible via the Carolina Michaelis metro station (lines A, B, C, E, F), followed by a short walk. Bus routes also serve the area.
